title: Time bound for pair duplication
statement: For every finite bit string $x$, the duplicator machine halts after exactly $4(|x|+1)$ steps and outputs the encoding consisting of each bit of $x$ repeated twice, followed by $01$ and then $x$.
replaced:
On every input $x$ the duplicator halts within $4(\abs{x}+1)$ steps with
output the self-delimiting pair code of $(x,x)$: each bit of $x$ doubled, then
the separator bits $0,1$, then $x$.
